title: Matched supervised baselines and constraint ablations for LanternQuest entity and relation extraction
integrity_statement: E27 and E27v2.1 remain immutable. E27v3 is a separate exploratory comparison. Every record is predicted out of fold and every method is scored with the same evaluator.

evaluation.fold_assignment: deterministic round robin stratified within source group
secondary_metrics: relation F1 with gold entity endpoints
evaluation.interpretation: record-level internal cross-validation; not source-held-out external validation

methods.name: bert-base-chinese BIO entity extraction and unrestricted relation classification
BERT_ONTOLOGY with exact-span evidence and audit gate
hfl/chinese-macbert-base with ontology and evidence gate
shared-encoder joint BIO and ordered-pair relation model

reporting_rules: XPKG values are external context and are not placed in the same ranking table.
Identical scores between ontology and evidence variants are retained rather than hidden.
No SOTA claim is made on a private corpus.
Original failed zero-shot results remain reportable.
Training-based results are publication-conditional until local model-training rights are documented.
